journey: Resumed the isolated six-team save with 72 draft picks and 12 players per team.
Compared Larry Johnson for Marshall Faulk: A+, +4.4 estimated points/game, 0% current-rule acceptance. A LaDainian Tomlinson package showed C, -1.7 and 100%.
Sent one proposal, tr2. Messages showed the exact pending packages; Review focused tr2 in the Inbox. Reload preserved one offer.
Ran waivers. The AI rejected tr2, matching its 0% preview. Messages showed Rejected; Review focused tr2 in the Trade Log.
Moved Lamar Jackson into the QB slot using the actual swap dialog, locked the lineup and started Week 1.
Finished saved playback. The 86.60–89.86 final equals the nine visible starter totals on each side. LaDainian Tomlinson’s scoring receipt reconciled to 21.00.
Ended the week. The Week 2 Wire showed the actual Week 1 result and accepted trades. Reload and named Resume preserved one saved week, the 0–1 record and all six exact box scores.
Replayed Week 1 without changing results. Pause held the clock unchanged across review. Scored live and final views fit all 18 players at the three checked desktop sizes.
Instant releases its disappearing button, restores the header to 22px and focuses Week 1 matchup. Final Replay and Close actions remain visible.
